Class Carriage

java.lang.Object
domain.Carriage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Carriage extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a carriage capable of carrying cargo. A carriage has a specific cargo type, a maximum allowed cargo capacity, and tracks the current cargo amount it holds.

  • Constructor Details

    • Carriage

      public Carriage(Cargo cargo, int maxCargo, int currentCargo)
      Creates a new Carriage for transporting cargo. A carriage has a defined type of cargo, a maximum cargo capacity, and a specified amount of current cargo it is holding.
      Parameters:
      cargo - the type of cargo that the carriage is designated to hold
      maxCargo - the maximum capacity of cargo the carriage can hold
      currentCargo - the initial amount of cargo stored in the carriage

  • Method Details

    • getCargo

      public Cargo getCargo()
      Retrieves the cargo currently assigned to the carriage.
      Returns:
      the current cargo carried by the carriage

    • getCargoType

      public Cargo.Type getCargoType()
      Retrieves the type of the cargo currently assigned to the carriage.

    • getMaxCargo

      public int getMaxCargo()
      Retrieves the maximum cargo capacity of the carriage.
      Returns:
      the maximum amount of cargo the carriage can hold

    • getCurrentCargo

      public int getCurrentCargo()
      Retrieves the current amount of cargo in the carriage.
      Returns:
      the current cargo level in the carriage

    • setCargo

      public boolean setCargo(Cargo newCargo)
      Sets the cargo for the carriage if the current cargo load is zero. This method assigns the provided cargo to the carriage only if it is currently empty.
      Parameters:
      newCargo - the new cargo to be assigned to the carriage
      Returns:
      true if the cargo was successfully set, false if the current cargo load is not zero

    • addCargo

      public void addCargo(int amount)
      Adds the specified amount of cargo to the carriage. The final cargo will not exceed the maximum cargo capacity of the carriage.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount of cargo to add to the carriage

    • removeCargo

      public void removeCargo(int amount)
      Removes the specified amount of cargo from the carriage. The resulting cargo level will not drop below zero.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount of cargo to remove from the carriage

    • fillCarriage

      public void fillCarriage()
      Fills the carriage to its maximum cargo capacity. This method utilizes the addCargo method to add cargo until the current cargo level reaches the maximum allowable capacity.

    • emptyCarriage

      public void emptyCarriage()
      Removes all current cargo from the carriage. This method sets the current cargo level to zero by removing an amount equal to the current cargo.
